verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a provider-agnostic interface for Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and Open Responses providers. OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM and others connect via a custom Base URL. Users can switch models mid-conversation or run two side-by-side, and Codex or Claude Code subscriptions can serve as chat backends. Missing for 10: documented native Anthropic and Google API connectors (beyond OpenAI-compatible routing or Function plugins), explicit per-agent model selection, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.
